ModMetaData.name: HermesVoice
ModMetaData.author: charless
ModMetaData.description:
Live LLM-driven pawn dialogue, powered by an external agent bridge.
HermesVoice watches your colony - injuries, deaths, mental breaks, skill level-ups, medical tending, social interactions, raids - sends those moments to the agent (each kind can be toggled in settings), and shows the agent's replies as in-character speech bubbles spoken by the pawns themselves.
The mod dials out to a Hermes agent bridge over your local network (Tailscale). The agent roleplays your colonists using their full in-game context, and the lines appear as overhead dialogue boxes, recorded to a conversation log.
An authenticated HTTP bridge (default port 9765) exposes colony state, events and pawn minds so the agent can read the world and speak as pawns in real time. Spoken lines appear as bubbles and in the pawns' Log tabs, and can nudge moods and opinions (adjustable in settings). Other mods can add context through a small API.
Setup: 1. Install the Harmony mod (v3, Steam Workshop). 2. Run the Hermes bridge on your agent machine (see the README at https://github.com/CharlesMod/rimworld-hermes). 3. Mod settings: set the Agent dial-out URL. The agent finds the bridge port and token in HermesVoice/bridge.json in the RimWorld config folder; set a fixed shared token in settings only if the agent runs on another machine.
